props.title: Why a Quantum Particle Leaks Into a Wall It Can't Climb

beats.narration_text: A ball without enough energy to climb a hill just rolls back down the slope.
beats.tts_normalized_text: A ball without enough energy to climb a hill just rolls back down the slope.
beats.new_visual_element: a person watching a ball roll up a hill and back down
beats.start_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = a person watching a ball partway up a hill]
beats.end_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = the person watching the ball roll back down the hill]
beats.video_animation_prompt: the person and a hill draw in; a ball rolls partway up and rolls back down; no hand visible, white background, napkin art doodle style
beats.negative_prompt: hand, fingers, arm, pencil, pen, marker, stylus, writing tool, shadow, paper texture, yellowing, gradient, photorealistic, 3D render, gray shading, color, brush, eraser, artifacts, distortion, camera movement, zoom, pan, wiggle, blur

beats.narration_text: But a quantum particle's wave seeps into the hillside before it turns back.
beats.tts_normalized_text: But a quantum particle's wave seeps into the hillside before it turns back.
beats.new_visual_element: the person surprised as a wave glows into the hill
beats.start_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = a person surprised as a glowing wave seeps into a hillside]
beats.end_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = the person watching a faint wave fade into the hill]
beats.video_animation_prompt: the person draws in; a glowing wave seeps a little way into the hillside then fades; the person is surprised; no hand visible, white background, napkin art doodle style
beats.negative_prompt: hand, fingers, arm, pencil, pen, marker, stylus, writing tool, shadow, paper texture, yellowing, gradient, photorealistic, 3D render, gray shading, color, brush, eraser, artifacts, distortion, camera movement, zoom, pan, wiggle, blur

beats.narration_text: Here's the setup: open space on the left, a forbidden wall on the right.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Here's the setup: open space on the left, a forbidden wall on the right.
beats.new_visual_element: baseline, a wall at center, shaded forbidden zone on the right
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: draw a baseline, a vertical wall at the centre, and shade the right side red as the forbidden zone labelled 'not enough energy'

beats.narration_text: A classical ball rolls up to the wall and simply turns back.
beats.tts_normalized_text: A classical ball rolls up to the wall and simply turns back.
beats.new_visual_element: a ball rolls to the wall and bounces back
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: a ball rolls in from the left to the wall, then rolls back; label 'turns back'

beats.narration_text: Now the quantum particle: it arrives as an oscillating wave.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Now the quantum particle: it arrives as an oscillating wave.
beats.new_visual_element: an oscillating wave on the allowed side up to the wall
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: draw an oscillating wave on the left, reaching the wall at a non-zero value

beats.narration_text: At the wall it can't cut to zero — the wave has to stay smooth.
beats.tts_normalized_text: At the wall it can't cut to zero — the wave has to stay smooth.
beats.new_visual_element: the boundary value marked at the wall (non-zero, smooth)
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: mark the wave's value at the wall with a dot; note it must join smoothly, not drop to zero

beats.narration_text: So inside the wall it switches from waving to a fading exponential decay.
beats.tts_normalized_text: So inside the wall it switches from waving to a fading exponential decay.
beats.new_visual_element: the continued oscillation morphs into a decaying tail in the shaded zone
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: show a faded naive oscillation continuing into the forbidden zone, then morph it into a smooth exponential decay tail

beats.narration_text: The tail reaches only a finite distance in before dying away.
beats.tts_normalized_text: The tail reaches only a finite distance in before dying away.
beats.new_visual_element: a bracket showing the finite penetration depth
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: bracket the penetration depth of the decay tail; label 'finite reach'

beats.narration_text: The particle is still reflected — but its wave reached where it's classically forbidden to be.
beats.tts_normalized_text: The particle is still reflected — but its wave reached where it's classically forbidden to be.
beats.new_visual_element: a reflected-back arrow on the allowed side
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: add a leftward 'reflected' arrow on the allowed side while the decay tail stays in the forbidden zone

beats.narration_text: Oscillating outside, fading inside — the wave leaks into a wall it can never climb.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Oscillating outside, fading inside — the wave leaks into a wall it can never climb.
beats.new_visual_element: red label 'the wave leaks into the forbidden wall'
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: settle the picture and write a red label 'the wave leaks into the forbidden wall'; clean close

beats.narration_text: Part of the Bears Notes series.
